title: Bank Deposit Compliance Holds: Answer Periods, Review Times and Fee Refunds
content:
When compliance holds a Bank Deposit transfer and asks the customer for information about it, three tier figures apply: how long the customer has to answer, how long compliance takes to clear the hold once the answer is complete, and what share of the transfer fee is refunded when Paloma cancels a held transfer.

| Tier | Calendar days to answer a request for information | Paloma business days for compliance to clear the hold after a complete answer | Share of the transfer fee refunded when Paloma cancels a held transfer (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 10 | 2 | 100 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 10 | 2 | 100 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 7 | 1 | 100 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 7 | 1 | 100 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 14 | 3 | 100 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 14 | 3 | 100 |

## Definitions

- **Answer period.** The calendar days the customer has to answer a transfer-level request for information before the transfer is cancelled.
- **Hold review time.** The Paloma business days compliance takes to clear a hold once its request for information is answered; the date of availability is then re-disclosed from the release.
- **Fee refund on a Paloma cancellation.** The share of the transfer fee refunded when Paloma cancels a held transfer.

## Reading the table

The real-time tiers (Express, Express Plus) give the shortest answer period, 7 days, and the shortest review, 1 business day. Large Amount and International Wire give 14 days and 3 business days. On every tier a transfer Paloma cancels from a hold has its transfer fee refunded in full (100 percent).
